Ruth CS: quick sync for Northstar-Sentry private/VPC onboarding — focus: audit log delivery, KMS access for their log-writer, IAM trust, and renewal risk if not validated by next Tue. Who has blockers?
Leah (Northstar): thanks Ruth. Blockers: (1) audit events not appearing in our SIEM, (2) our ops can't finish rotating keys until KMS policy updated, (3) occasional 403 from the forwarder lambda.
Omar (Network): seeing outbound resets from the forwarder subnet. Leah, can you confirm collector IPs and whether they require mTLS?
Leah (Northstar): collectors: ns-collector-1.northstar.cloud (13.59.77.121) and ns-collector-2.northstar.cloud (13.59.77.122). They accept TLS only, no mTLS.
Omar (Network): I'll narrow egress to those two IPs and open tcp/6514 only. ETA 25m. Command I will run: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0f1e2d --protocol tcp --port 6514 --cidr 13.59.77.121/32 then add second IP.
Sasha (SolutionsEng): IAM: provide role arn: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/northstar-log-writer. We need that in their sidecar trust policy and allow sts:AssumeRole from our logging principal. Also the KMS key policy needs to permit decrypt/generate for that role.
Vik (Security): KMS policy note: we can allow kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey for the role but must scope by EncryptionContext to the stream name. Draft stanza: {"Sid":"AllowNorthstarLogs","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/northstar-log-writer"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:stream":"northstar-audit"}}} — will paste final JSON to the shared drive in 30m.
Sasha (SolutionsEng): propose key rotation window Mon 04:00 UTC (low traffic). Leah, can Northstar do that?
Leah (Northstar): Mon 04:00 UTC works. We'll suspend ingestion for ~10m and re-run tests.
Ruth CS: action items: 1) Omar to apply egress lock to collector IPs (ETA 25m). 2) Vik to post final KMS JSON (ETA 30m). 3) Sasha to schedule rotation Mon 04:00 UTC and invite Northstar. 4) Leah to paste a post-rotation sample and confirm SIEM receipt. Renewal check Tue — if audit + rotation not validated, renewal rep asked to trigger escalation.
deploy-bot: forwarder-deploy #9901 started -> status: running
Omar (Network): egress rules applied, verified TCP 6514 connect from test instance to both collectors.
deploy-bot: forwarder-deploy #9901 finished -> status: success, 0 errors
Leah (Northstar): after KMS update and egress change retried: now seeing 200s and ingest ack. sample: \"{\"ts\":\"2026-03-24T07:12:05Z\",\"status\":200,\"msg\":\"ingest accepted\"}\"
Ruth CS: great — marking thread in-flight. I will post a concise pre-renewal health note tomorrow. If anything regresses, please @me immediately. :white_check_mark:
